description: Blocks destructive Git and Homework 08 cluster commands before they run.

hooks.commandWindows: python -c "import pathlib, runpy, subprocess; root = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True).strip(); runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(root) / '.codex' / 'hooks' / 'pre_tool_use_policy.py'), run_name='__main__')"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking Git and cluster command safety
